promotion.truth_boundary: The verified Gemini output may inform SOVARA source-level design candidates only. It does not authorize deployment, provider effects, production traffic, spend, publishing, external communication, legal/rights clearance, realised ROI claims, or autonomous optimization.

decisions.normalized_objective: Measure and improve cross-shot character/environment continuity using reference and asset evidence without claiming guaranteed identity preservation.
decisions.proof_gate: Bounded synthetic continuity court with declared similarity metric, threshold, false-match controls and human visual review.

decisions.normalized_objective: Compose deterministic brand-policy checks with rights metadata and QA without claiming comprehensive IP-law adjudication.
decisions.proof_gate: Injected-policy regression suite with false-positive and false-negative reporting; legal clearance remains outside automated authority.

decisions.normalized_objective: Evaluate reuse-first audio synchronization before any NEW_LAST build or provider effect.
decisions.proof_gate: Federation reuse scan plus synthetic timing/alignment prototype; no external audio generation authority inherited.

decisions.normalized_objective: Extend packaging with subject-aware multi-format adaptation and measurable safe-zone retention.
decisions.proof_gate: Synthetic 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 regression corpus with subject-retention and resolution checks.

decisions.normalized_objective: Compose brief and meta-studio outputs into a reversible storyboard/animatic planning artifact.
decisions.proof_gate: Five-shot synthetic brief court with timing, editability and no-provider-effect local fallback.

decisions.normalized_objective: Build an offline commercial-performance research model only after provenance-bound historical SC-PULSE data exists; never treat predicted ROAS as realised ROI.
decisions.proof_gate: Time-split validation on sufficient real historical observations with calibration/error reporting and holdout performance; no deterministic ROI claim.

decisions.normalized_objective: Reuse reference/studio color controls to improve measurable grade consistency while protecting skin-tone and clipping constraints.
decisions.proof_gate: Synthetic/reference color-difference court with skin-tone and banding regressions.

decisions.normalized_objective: Extend SC-ASSET with content-addressed non-destructive creative version lineage and deterministic rollback.
decisions.proof_gate: Branch/edit/rollback/merge simulation with exact hash lineage and no silent overwrite.

decisions.normalized_objective: Compose SC-ROUTER and existing FinOps capability into a cost-quality route planner; savings remain unproven until observed on equivalent workloads.
decisions.proof_gate: Deterministic route simulation first, then separately authorized same-workload provider cohort with cost/quality/readback evidence.

decisions.normalized_objective: Design a consent/rights/provenance registry and approval ledger; never auto-declare legal clearance or compensation authority.
decisions.proof_gate: Synthetic rights-lifecycle court plus privacy/security review and explicit human/policy authority for any real-person or contractual effect.

decisions.normalized_objective: Start with an offline/shadow performance-to-brief learning loop; no live platform writeback or autonomous campaign tuning is inherited.
decisions.proof_gate: Replay historical/synthetic performance events through a shadow learner, compare proposed brief changes, then require separate connector/readback and production authority.

decisions.normalized_objective: Separate editable typography from generated pixels and preserve licensing/layout metadata across formats and translations.
decisions.proof_gate: Synthetic multilingual layout court with clipping, font-license metadata and editability checks.
